'''Alex Antor Seignourel'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Antor|Seignourel}} (born 1 April 1979)<ref name=sref>{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/an/alex-antor-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418010609/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/an/alex-antor-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |accessdate=15 December 2012 |quote=Full name: Alex Antor Seignourel}}</ref> is an [[Andorra]]n [[alpine skier]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.fis-ski.com/uk/604/613.html?sector=AL&listid=&competitorid=1462&type=result |title=FIS profile |access-date=2008-02-29 |archive-date=2011-05-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110526074414/http://www.fis-ski.com/uk/604/613.html?sector=AL&listid=&competitorid=1462&type=result |url-status=dead }}</ref> He represented Andorra at the [[2002 Winter Olympics|2002]] and [[2006 Winter Olympics]]. He was their [[flag bearer]] in the [[2006 Winter Olympics#Day 1 .28Opening Ceremony.29|2006 Opening Ceremonies]].
